name: MATH 2142Q
title: Advanced Calculus II
description: A continuation of the rigorous treatment of the mathematics underlying the main results of one variable calculus. Basic properties of vectors and vector valued functions. May be used in place of MATH 1132Q, 1152Q or 2710 to fulfill any requirement satisfied by MATH 1132Q, 1152Q or 2710.
requirement_description: MATH 2141Q. May not be taken out of sequence after passing MATH 2110Q, MATH 2130Q, MATH 2143Q, MATH 2210Q, MATH 2410Q, or MATH 2420Q.
